item.title: Show HN: Spacescience.tech – A Bubble Shooter mixed with 2048
item.summary: Made this with Claude + Codex since I was bored, wanted a fun game to play on the plane and though the two would work well together. So far I've had fun with it, so I decided to share. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49179948 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
